Volunteers Make the Difference

Local elections like this one are decided by a handful of votes. Your two hours of volunteering can make the difference between winning and losing. We need people tonight and on Election Day.

This is it. With Election Day tomorrow, these are our last chances to reach undecided voters. Every volunteer slot matters. Sign up now.

Why volunteering matters here

Local elections are small

Municipal measures often pass or fail by fewer than 200 votes. A single volunteer can speak to that many people in one shift at a polling place.

Neighbor-to-neighbor persuasion works

Research shows that a conversation with a real person — not a mailer, not an ad — is far more likely to change a vote or motivate an undecided neighbor.

This is the moment

The library has been here for your whole life. Showing up for two hours on Election Day is a small thing that will echo for years in this community.

Every vote matters. Every hour matters.

Sign up above, or at minimum — vote yes on June 18 and tell your friends.
